sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: The candidate is semantically faithful and deterministicValidation.valid is true. It preserves the approved-analysis/formula alternatives, ship and load-case ownership, required operands and evidence terms, exact inclusive 0.8 ratio bounds, weakest-direction confirmation, permitted direct-calculation formulas, expected-result-scaled tolerances, and the conditional blade-failure status check without unsupported functions or invented canonical terms.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: Repair the load-case constraint to require bladeFailureLoadApplicationRadiusRatio = 0.8 (using equal inclusive numeric bounds on qudt:numericValue), not merely require its presence. The formula SPARQL also uses ABS, which is outside the DIRECT_CALCULATION operator set; replace it with an allowed simple piecewise expression (or an equivalent permitted formulation) while retaining tolerance scaled from the expected reference-strength and expected-load results, not from the reported values.

Deterministic validation prevents acceptance. Fix: Unknown canonical benchmark IRI(s): https://w3id.org/nltl/vocab#TRF101_DimensionlessQuantityShape, https://w3id.org/nltl/vocab#TRF101_ForceQuantityShape, https://w3id.org/nltl/vocab#TRF101_FormulaShape, https://w3id.org/nltl/vocab#TRF101_LengthQuantityShape, https://w3id.org/nltl/vocab#TRF101_LoadCaseShape, https://w3id.org/nltl/vocab#TRF101_PressureQuantityShape, https://w3id.org/nltl/vocab#TRF101_ShipShape
Semantic validator feedback: Repair the candidate before freezing: deterministic validation is invalid because all TRF101_*Shape IRIs are unknown canonical terms; use blank node shapes or a non-canonical private shape namespace, not invented terms in the project vocabulary namespace. Preserve the prior ratio repair by constraining the load-case ratio's qudt:numericValue with equal inclusive bounds 0.8–0.8 (do not use numeric sh:hasValue), while retaining its dimensionless unit and weakest-direction confirmation. The formula branch must remain a violation test for the permitted direct-calculation formulas with tolerance scaled from the expected reference strength and expected load; do not use ABS or exact equality for derived results. Ensure the approval-analysis OR formula alternative does not make both branches mandatory and that all ship-owned operands/results, the ship-to-loadCase relationship, and declared evidence terms remain represented.

The candidate is semantically faithful and deterministicValidation.valid is true. It preserves the approved-analysis/formula alternatives, ship and load-case ownership, required operands and evidence terms, exact inclusive 0.8 ratio bounds, weakest-direction confirmation, permitted direct-calculation formulas, expected-result-scaled tolerances, and the conditional blade-failure status check without unsupported functions or invented canonical terms.
